summary: Completed comprehensive testing of ElevenLabs TTS audio narration feature. All backend APIs and frontend UI controls are working correctly with proper caching, paywall enforcement, and user interactions.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/audio/voices returns enabled: true with 3 voices (male, female, documentary)
Backend: GET /api/posts/{slug}/audio?voice=male returns cached MP3 with X-Audio-Cache: hit header
Backend: Paywall enforcement - anonymous users get preview scope (~429 KB) for premium essays
Backend: Paywall enforcement - admin users get full scope (~1.25 MB) for premium essays
Backend: Free essays return full scope for all users (~1.97 MB)
Backend: Invalid voice parameter returns 400 error
Frontend: AudioNarrator component loads and displays correctly
Frontend: Play button starts audio playback with time display (m:ss / m:ss format)
Frontend: Time advances correctly during playback
Frontend: Pause button pauses playback with 'Paused' status
Frontend: Resume button resumes playback from paused state
Frontend: Restart button resets playback to 0:00
Frontend: Speed selector changes playback speed (tested 1.5×) without interrupting audio
Frontend: Voice selector displays default 'George — warm male' voice
Frontend: Progress bar is seekable - clicking jumps to that position in audio
Frontend: Article body, navigation, and related posts unaffected by audio feature
